images.title: The trail through the chapter
images.purpose: Give the summary a map: six stops on one winding trail, one for each idea of the chapter, so the student can walk through them in order.
images.composition: A loop-shaped trail with six round stops, each with a simple symbol and the name of one idea, and the words Animal Jumps in the middle.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. A winding trail drawn as one thick rounded path (44 px wide, light grey #6B7280 at 40 percent, with a thin dark #2B2B2B edge) that links 6 round stops in order along a loop: from stop 1 at the upper left, right through stop 2 at the top middle to stop 3 at the upper right, down to stop 4 at the lower right, left through stop 5 at the bottom middle to stop 6 at the lower left. Each stop is a circle 150 px across with a 4 px dark outline and a flat symbol inside, with its name in dark #1F2937 bold (34 px) centred 120 px away from the stop on the outer side of the loop: stop 1, Factors and multiples, centred at (230, 230), filled #0072B2; stop 2, Arrays, centred at (728, 170), filled #E69F00; stop 3, Prime numbers, centred at (1226, 230), filled #CC79A7; stop 4, Common multiples, centred at (1226, 530), filled #0072B2; stop 5, Common factors, centred at (728, 600), filled #E69F00; stop 6, Checking statements, centred at (230, 530), filled #CC79A7. Symbols (no numbers in any of them): stop 1 a bold multiplication sign; stop 2 a small block of 2 rows of 3 tiny squares; stop 3 a single row of 5 tiny squares; stop 4 two overlapping arcs; stop 5 two overlapping circles; stop 6 a tick next to a cross. In the centre of the loop, centred at x 728 and y 400, the words Animal Jumps (60 px, bold, dark). No other text and no numbers anywhere. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The chapter is one trail with six stops: factors and multiples, arrays, prime numbers, common multiples, common factors and checking statements.
images.description: A winding trail with six stops named factors and multiples, arrays, prime numbers, common multiples, common factors and checking statements.
images.context: Summary image for Chapter Revision. It shows the order of the chapter's ideas along Mowgli's trail and carries no worked numbers.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say one fact at each stop. The slip to watch is skipping the middle stops.

image_decisions.why: A map of the chapter's six ideas along the trail gives the summary one picture to walk through.
